newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens on the pound.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens on the pound.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr weakened on the pound on Wednesday, reversing an advance seen last month, the central National Bank of Ethiopia said on Wednesday.
The birr was quoted at a commercial mean rate of 9.8961 to the pound on Wednesday from 9.8551 in August.
Following the September 14 currency auction, the birr rate versus the dollar remains 6.36 in the period to September 22. The central bank also posted the following birr-international currency rates.
Birr-mark at 4.2096, birr-Italian lire at 0.004170, birr-Swiss franc at 5.1302, birr-French franc at 1.2377, birr-Belgian franc at 0.204620, birr-Dutch guilder at 3.7575.
Birr-Swedish kroner at 0.9600, birr-Norwegian kroner at 0.9840, birr-Danish kroner at 1.0950, birr-Austrian shilling at 0.5994 and birr-Djibouti franc at 0.0362.
Birr-Indian rupee at 0.1796, birr-Kenyan shilling at 0.1129, birr-Japanese yen at 0.057786, birr-Canadian dollar at 4.6423, birr-Australian dollar at 5.0180, birr-ECU at 8.050488.
